calculation.description: Use an eight-session lagged contrarian return, normalized by lagged 40-session idiosyncratic volatility and multiplied by a lagged cross-asset dispersion regime gate. Apply a five-session exponential smoothing and cross-sectional 5th/95th percentile winsorization. All signal inputs precede the decision date; forward validation horizon is ten trading sessions.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark-wide absolute daily paper IC >= 0.0070 and absolute daily paper ICIR >= 0.0840 using 1,994 daily cross-sectional observations and all 15 tradable assets. Recent windows are mixed but the 750-session ICIR is strong; uncertainty remains material for a 15-asset cross-section.

provenance.method: lagged close-only daily panel; Spearman cross-sectional IC; dates with at least 8 valid instruments
